name: GIN-Dock-Wallpaper
description: Unified Smart Hot-Corner Dock Bar & 4K Wallpaper Calendar HUD Engine for Windows 10/11
author: GinCz / Vladimir Bulantsev & Antigravity
features: Fonts Relocation to Wallpaper & Calendar Tab: 12 curated font buttons moved from Settings Tab 1 to Tab 2
Direct Desktop Wallpaper & Calendar Generation on Font Click: clicking a font button keeps settings window fonts clean and immediately generates a fresh 4K wallpaper with the newly selected font
4-Button Responsive Calendar Scale: replaced trackbar with 4 dedicated scale buttons (Small, Medium, Large, Huge) that instantly regenerate wallpaper HUD in the selected scale
Non-Dropping Wallpaper Queue: rapid font or scale clicks are queued without drops or socket hangs
Strict 2-Version Retention: kept strictly v037 and v038 in MEGA desktop and git repositories
